termination.dragHint: Drop at the core · Esc cancels
termination.release: Release to review ending this process
termination.title: End {{name}}?
termination.demoNotice: This is demo data. Only this simulated organism will be removed; no real process is affected.
termination.nativeNotice: This forcefully ends the process. Unsaved work may be lost. Only this PID is ended, not its child processes.
termination.stale: The process exited, its identity changed, or the data mode switched. Cancel and select it again.
termination.protected: Critical system processes, the desktop shell and this application's processes cannot be ended here.
termination.identity: Could not verify the process identity. No termination was performed.
termination.denied: The process exited or access was denied.
termination.unsupported: Use the Windows desktop app to end real processes.
termination.timeout: Termination was requested, but exit is not confirmed yet. Wait for the system data to refresh.
termination.failed: Could not end the process. Cancel, refresh and retry.

artwork.animationOwnership: Replace the capture parts for your theme. The app handles reaching, wrapping, drop feedback and retrieval. Missing artwork inherits the built-in theme.
artwork.cellOrder: Atlas order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Sizes below are recommendations.
artwork.captureNote: Approaching the core reaches and wraps; confirming retrieves the process. Upload matching capture parts below.
artwork.storageFailed: Could not save locally. Storage may be full; try smaller images. Your active theme has not been replaced.
artwork.intro: Describe your world, give the prompt to an image AI, then upload each PNG to its slot. Save to use it or export the complete theme.
artwork.brief: What should your theme look like?
artwork.briefPlaceholder: For example: a rainy glass greenhouse, moss and dew, teal and amber glow…
artwork.copied: Copied. Paste into an AI that supports image generation.
artwork.copyFallback: Automatic copy is unavailable. Select and copy the text below.
artwork.specs: PNG, up to 8 MiB each and 64 MiB total. Landscape background; even-sided squares for other roles, exact 2×2 atlas grids. Use pure black or real transparency. Partial replacement is welcome.
artwork.progress: {{count}} artwork slots replaced. Empty slots inherit built-in artwork.
artwork.invalidImage: This PNG could not be decoded. Export it again and retry.
artwork.imageTooLarge: Image exceeds 8 MiB. Compress it before uploading.
artwork.setTooLarge: Artwork exceeds 64 MiB in total. Compress or remove some images.
artwork.imageDimensions: Image sides must be 64–4096px, with at most 9,437,184 pixels.
artwork.imageShape: Background aspect ratio must be 1.3–2.4. Other images must be even-sided squares.
artwork.replaceNotice: A theme with this ID exists. Installing will replace it and its artwork.
artwork.importNotice: Validation passed. Confirm to save locally and apply this theme.

hints.battery: Power supplied by the battery while unplugged and discharging. This is not wall-socket power consumption. Updates with the sampling interval.
hints.intel: Power derived from the Intel driver package-domain energy counter. The measured components depend on the hardware; this is not total computer power or wall-socket consumption. Updates with the sampling interval.
hints.demo: Generated for the demo. This is not a measurement of this computer. Use the desktop app with Demo data turned off for local readings.
hints.unavailable: No supported power reading is available. Battery discharge requires running on battery; Intel package readings require a supported device and driver; the first reading needs two samples. Missing readings are shown as a dash.
hints.waiting: Local power data has not arrived. Run the desktop app with Demo data turned off to read supported sensors.
hints.stale: The collector has not returned a recent power sample. The reading will return automatically when fresh data arrives.
